newsitem.title: INDONESIA: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - May 28.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - May 28.

text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Indonesian press on May 28. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
The Indonesian military have asked Jakarta residents not to believe in rumours circulated in the capital about bomb threats and other disturbances ahead of the May 29 general elections.

Indonesia's state-run carrier Garuda Indonesia has replaced its Airbus A330-300s with McDonnell's DC-10 on its flights to Hong Kong because they have been temporarily banned there. The airline said it would continue to run Airbuses on other routes because it had not received any orders to ground the jets.
Indonesia will continue to seek bilateral solutions to the dispute over its national car policy, but has no intention of offering compensation to any of the parties protesting the policy.

Indonesia's National Commission of Human Rights has said it will send a fact-finding team to Banjarmasin, the capital of South Kalimantan province, where more than 130 people died in a fire during rioting last Friday.
